note: 四端（Mac / iOS / Android / 鸿蒙）启动器的「一套体验」规格。状态、文案、错误码、任务事件到界面的映射只在这里定义一次；各端只负责画，不另写一套措辞。错误码的「下一步」不在本文件里写第二份：一律指向 pack/jobs/errors.py 的 RECOVERY（口径见 README.md）。口径号 revision 改动规则见 README.md。

pack_graphics_mode.note: #389（iOS「关于本包」）与 #387（Mac 启动器画面模式）同源于 IPA 的 Info.plist，两句文案两处逐字相同；改字面必须同一次改这两个源文件。包只出直连（11-07 拆通用模式），S2AGraphicsMode 不是 direct 一律按未知。

unknown.en: Unknown (this package did not record a graphics mode)

terminal_results.note: 任务终态，不是错误码：没有 severity / retryable，也不查 errors 表。

detail.zh-Hans: 任务已完成，使用本次交付的安装包与资源包。
detail.en: The job finished; use the installer and resource pack produced by this run.

detail.zh-Hans: 任务被取消了；需要时重新发起，已有成功产物保留。
detail.en: The job was cancelled; start it again when needed, successful artifacts are kept.

fields.stageId: 阶段机器名（pack/contracts/protocol.py STAGES 的右值）
fields.stageIndex: 第几个阶段，从 1 开始；与 stageCount 一起画阶段条
fields.total: 当前阶段总量；缺失时不画进度条，只画转圈
fields.code: 错误码，查 errors 表；终态码查 terminal_results
fields.nextAction: 下一步那句话，优先用事件里的这条（本机化后的），没有才回落到 pack/jobs/errors.py 的 RECOVERY

errors.note: 码集合 = RECOVERY 的键集合，外加 artifact_invalid（pack/targets/ios/adapter.py 抛，恢复口径在 pack/contracts/README.md）。每条只写标题 / 说明 / 严重度 / 能否重试 / 能否恢复；下一步一律由 next_action.from 指回源文件，本文件不写第二份文案。

title.zh-Hans: 游戏库所在磁盘格式不支持

detail.zh-Hans: 存档备份无效；具体原因见本任务的错误摘要。
detail.en: Invalid save backup. See this job’s error summary for the specific reason.

detail.zh-Hans: 存档恢复目录不存在；具体原因见本任务的错误摘要。
detail.en: Save restore directory missing. See this job’s error summary for the specific reason.

detail.zh-Hans: 存档回滚未完成；具体原因见本任务的错误摘要。
detail.en: Save rollback incomplete. See this job’s error summary for the specific reason.

detail.zh-Hans: 按你的确认跳过了没做完的存档回退；事务记录保留，下次启动会再试。
detail.en: The unfinished save rollback was skipped as you confirmed; the record is kept and recovery is retried next launch.

detail.zh-Hans: 存档备份空间不足；具体原因见本任务的错误摘要。
detail.en: Insufficient save backup space. See this job’s error summary for the specific reason.

detail.zh-Hans: 存档路径不安全；具体原因见本任务的错误摘要。
detail.en: Unsafe save path. See this job’s error summary for the specific reason.

detail.zh-Hans: 存档用户无效；具体原因见本任务的错误摘要。
detail.en: Invalid save user. See this job’s error summary for the specific reason.

detail.zh-Hans: 存档版本不匹配；具体原因见本任务的错误摘要。
detail.en: Save version mismatch. See this job’s error summary for the specific reason.

detail.zh-Hans: 存档所属游戏不匹配；具体原因见本任务的错误摘要。
detail.en: Save game mismatch. See this job’s error summary for the specific reason.

detail.zh-Hans: 存档所属用户不匹配；具体原因见本任务的错误摘要。
detail.en: Save user mismatch. See this job’s error summary for the specific reason.

prompts.note: 游戏内横幅（iOS / Mac 游戏窗口）与启动器共用同一份措辞，改这里要同步那个头文件，字面必须逐字一致。

items.zh-Hans: 当前磁盘不能安全保存：请把游戏库挪到本机磁盘。保存过程中强退，可能留下写了一半的存档。
items.en: This disk can't save safely: move the game library to this Mac's disk. Force-quitting while saving may leave a half-written save.

items.zh-Hans: 当前存储不能安全保存：保存过程中强退，可能留下写了一半的存档。请等游戏存完再退出。
items.en: This storage can't save safely: force-quitting while saving may leave a half-written save. Wait for the game to finish saving before you quit.

items.zh-Hans: 要点游戏自己的菜单，就切到触屏。左上角齿轮 → 按键布局，随时可以切回按键。
items.en: To tap the game's own menus, switch to touch. You can switch back to buttons anytime from the gear in the top-left corner → Button layout.

items.zh-Hans: 按 A 退出，按 B 回到游戏。退出前会等游戏把存档写完；没在游戏里存的进度会丢。
items.en: Press A to quit or B to return to the game. Quitting waits for the game to finish writing its save; progress you haven't saved in the game will be lost.

items.zh-Hans: 已切到触屏操作：这款游戏用触屏点菜单。左上角齿轮 → 按键布局，可以切回按键。
items.en: Switched to touch controls: this game uses touch for its menus. You can switch back to buttons from the gear in the top-left corner → Button layout.
End this game and return to the library

items.zh-Hans: S2Arm 会关闭，再点开就回到游戏库。
items.en: S2Arm closes; open it again to return to the game library.

items.zh-Hans: 请先在游戏里存档。确认后这局结束、S2Arm 关闭，再点开 S2Arm 就回到游戏库，选另一款开始。退出前会等游戏把存档写完；没在游戏里存的进度会丢。
items.en: Save in the game first. When you confirm, this game ends and S2Arm closes; open S2Arm again to return to the game library and pick another game. Quitting waits for the game to finish writing its save; progress you haven't saved in the game will be lost.

init_fail_page.note: iOS 人手局初启失败停在提示页（审计 #1534 P1-4）。上屏只放玩家话术：标题 + 按错误码映射的一句原因 + 下一步；内部摘要、错误码 id、构建号、翻译链、红行只进「复制诊断」的诊断文本（11-02 维护者：内部词不上屏）。游戏进程不读本文件，头文件的宏是实现来源，字面必须逐字一致；codes 与头文件 S2A_INIT_FAIL_CODES 一一对应，码表外的码按 unknown 用通用句。

items.zh-Hans: 请从后台划掉本 App 再打开；仍不行请点「复制诊断」把诊断发给我们。
items.en: Swipe this app away in the app switcher and open it again. If it still fails, tap "Copy diagnostics" and send it to us.

items.zh-Hans: 游戏需要的系统功能没能准备好。
items.en: System features the game needs couldn't be prepared.

items.zh-Hans: 本 App 没能准备好运行游戏。
items.en: This app couldn't get ready to run the game.

items.zh-Hans: 游戏程序没能开始运行。
items.en: The game program couldn't start running.

items.zh-Hans: 游戏文件缺失，请重新导入：在 电脑上的 S2Arm 里对这款游戏再点一次「装到 iPhone」。
items.en: Game files are missing. Import them again: in S2Arm on your computer, choose "Install on iPhone" for this game again.

selfcheck_page.note: iOS 起局自检不过时的提示页（runtime/src/selfcheck.c s2a_selfcheck_screen）。上屏只放玩家话术：标题 + 一句原因与下一步；地址上限、main.npdm、MB 这类细节只进 host.log（11-02 维护者：内部词不上屏）。判定顺序：NPDM 地址空间类型 0 / 2（32 位，布局只支持 36 / 39 位）→ as_*；没签权限 → ent_*；读不到本款要多大地址 → pkg_*；其余 → device_*。游戏进程不读本文件，头文件的宏是实现来源，字面必须逐字一致；每句带中英文，不复制进 Localizable.json。

items.zh-Hans: 安装少了一项必要权限
这款游戏要用「提高内存上限」权限。请用 电脑上的 S2Arm 对这款游戏点「装到 iPhone」重新装一次，会自动带上它。
items.en: This game needs the "Increased Memory Limit" permission. In S2Arm on your computer, click "Install on iPhone" for this game again; it will be included automatically.

items.zh-Hans: 请在 电脑上的 S2Arm 里对这款游戏再点一次「装到 iPhone」，它会把缺的补上。
items.en: In S2Arm on your computer, click "Install on iPhone" for this game again to add what's missing.

items.zh-Hans: 这台手机暂时玩不了这款游戏
items.en: This iPhone can't run this game yet

items.zh-Hans: 这款游戏要的内存超过了这台手机的系统上限，重新安装也解决不了。换一台内存更大的 iPhone 就能玩。
items.en: This game needs more memory than this iPhone's system limit allows, and reinstalling won't help. It will run on an iPhone with more memory.

items.zh-Hans: 这款游戏使用 32 位地址空间，S2Arm 暂不支持，重新安装或换手机都解决不了。
items.en: This game uses a 32-bit address space, which S2Arm doesn't support yet. Reinstalling or switching phones won't help.

launcher.note: 启动器客户端界面文案（Windows Avalonia 客户端 #1629 起；Mac 新前端可复用）。键 = 客户端界面元素 id，zh-Hans / en 两份必填，客户端按界面语言取，缺键显示 [键名]、不在客户端存副本。环境检查项本身的名称 / 说明 / 下一步与官方页由后端给（pack/jobs/winenv.py checks[].name / message / action / url）；错误码的标题 / 说明用本文件 errors 段。加键：同一提交加 zh-Hans + en，revision +1（README「口径号」规则）。

items.zh-Hans: 也可以把存档文件夹或 zip 直接拖进这个窗口，没玩过的游戏也能导入。
items.en: You can also drag a save folder or zip into this window, even for a game you haven't played yet.

items.zh-Hans: 先关掉游戏再操作。备份不会改动当前存档；恢复会覆盖当前存档，覆盖前自动留一份。
items.en: Quit the game first. Backing up leaves your current save untouched; restoring replaces it, and a copy of the current save is kept automatically first.

items.zh-Hans: 存档位置：这款游戏文件夹里的 SaveData。把原生格式的存档文件夹放进去（主机、JKSV / Checkpoint 等工具导出的，或别的设备上同一位置拷来的都行），下次开始游戏就用它；退出游戏后这里会更新成最新进度，整个文件夹拷到 iPhone 同一位置就能接着玩。
items.en: Save location: the SaveData folder inside this game's folder. Put a save folder in its original format there (exported from a console, JKSV / Checkpoint and similar tools, or copied from the same place on another device) and the game uses it the next time you start. When you quit, it's updated with your latest progress; copy the whole folder to the same place on iPhone to keep playing.

items.zh-Hans: 在访达中打开存档位置
存档位置里的存档没读进来：{0}。当前存档没有改动。
items.en: The save in the save location wasn't loaded: {0}. Your current save is unchanged.

items.zh-Hans: 有别的任务正在进行，等它结束再管理存档。
items.en: Another task is running. Wait for it to finish before managing saves.

items.zh-Hans: 正在恢复存档，请不要关掉 S2Arm…
items.en: Restoring the save. Keep S2Arm open…

items.zh-Hans: 这款还没有存档，先在游戏里存一次档。
items.en: This game has no save yet. Save once in the game first.

items.zh-Hans: 上次没做完的恢复已撤回，存档回到了恢复前的样子。
items.en: An unfinished restore was undone. The save is back to how it was before.

items.zh-Hans: 上次的恢复没做完，也没能自动撤回。可以先备份当前存档；下次启动游戏时会再试一次。
items.en: The last restore didn't finish and couldn't be undone automatically. You can back up the current save now; S2Arm will try again next time the game starts.
Save kept before the last restore

items.zh-Hans: 上次恢复覆盖掉的那份存档，想找回时可以用它恢复。
items.en: The save the last restore replaced. Restore from it to get it back.

items.zh-Hans: 把当前存档存成一个备份文件，放在你选的位置。
items.en: Saves the current save as a single backup file wherever you choose.
Choose where to keep the backup

items.zh-Hans: 先检查备份，确认后才恢复。别的游戏的备份、损坏的备份会被拒绝。
items.en: The backup is checked first and only restored after you confirm. Backups of another game or damaged backups are refused.

items.zh-Hans: S2Arm 备份文件，或 JKSV、Checkpoint、yuzu、Ryujinx 的存档文件夹或 zip。
items.en: An S2Arm backup file, or a save folder or zip from JKSV, Checkpoint, yuzu or Ryujinx.

items.zh-Hans: 备份完好，和这款游戏对得上
items.en: Backup is intact and matches this game

items.zh-Hans: 用这份备份覆盖当前存档？
items.en: Replace the current save with this backup?

items.zh-Hans: 「%@」现在的存档会被这份备份整个替换。替换前会自动留一份当前存档，之后可以在这里找回。
items.en: The current save of “%@” will be fully replaced by this backup. A copy of the current save is kept automatically first, so you can get it back here.

items.zh-Hans: 恢复好了。原来的存档已自动留了一份。
items.en: Restored. A copy of the previous save was kept.

items.zh-Hans: 存档信息读不全，请重新试一次。
items.en: Couldn't read all the save details. Please try again.

items.zh-Hans: 操作没做完就中断了，请重新读取存档后再试一次。
items.en: The operation stopped before finishing. Read the save again, then try once more.

items.zh-Hans: 改好后点保存，下次开始游戏时生效。
items.en: Save your changes and they apply the next time you start the game.

items.zh-Hans: 这款游戏之前存的键位读不出来，下面先显示默认键位；保存后会替换掉它。
items.en: The controls saved for this game couldn't be read, so the defaults are shown. Saving replaces them.
Click a button to set it

items.zh-Hans: 摇杆周围的箭头是推杆方向。HOME 和截图键只是示意。
items.en: The arrows around a stick are its directions. HOME and Capture are shown for reference only.
Press a key, Esc to cancel

items.zh-Hans: 改的是这台电脑上用哪个键，游戏里显示的按键图标不会变。
items.en: This changes which key you press on this computer. The button icons in the game stay the same.

items.zh-Hans: 这个按键和别的按键用了同一个键，改掉才能保存。
items.en: This button shares a key with another button. Change one to save.

items.zh-Hans: 键盘：{0} 和 {1} 用了同一个键
items.en: Keyboard: {0} and {1} use the same key

items.zh-Hans: 鼠标：{0} 和 {1} 用了同一个鼠标键
items.en: Mouse: {0} and {1} use the same mouse button

items.zh-Hans: 手柄：{0} 和 {1} 用了同一个按钮
items.en: Controller: {0} and {1} use the same button

items.zh-Hans: 摇杆：{0} 和 {1} 用了同一个方向
items.en: Sticks: {0} and {1} use the same axis

items.zh-Hans: 转动视角时，点一下游戏画面锁住鼠标；锁住时按 Esc 先松开鼠标，再按一次才算游戏里的按键。
items.en: To turn the camera, click the game to lock the mouse. While it's locked, Esc releases it first; press Esc again to use it in the game.

items.zh-Hans: 接手柄时按 Switch 的按键位置对应；只支持一位玩家。
items.en: A connected controller follows the Switch button positions. One player only.

items.zh-Hans: 摇杆死区（轻推多少才算数）
items.en: Dead zone (how far before a push counts)

items.zh-Hans: 没能保存：键位格式不对，请恢复默认后再改。
items.en: Couldn't save: the controls are in the wrong format. Restore the defaults and try again.

items.zh-Hans: 没能保存：键位不完整，请恢复默认后再改。
items.en: Couldn't save: the controls are incomplete. Restore the defaults and try again.

items.zh-Hans: 没能保存：里面有认不出的按键，请恢复默认后再改。
items.en: Couldn't save: there's a button it doesn't recognize. Restore the defaults and try again.

items.zh-Hans: 没能保存：有一个键盘按键认不出，请换一个键。
items.en: Couldn't save: one keyboard key isn't recognized. Pick another key.

items.zh-Hans: 没能保存：有一个鼠标键认不出，请重新选。
items.en: Couldn't save: one mouse button isn't recognized. Pick it again.

items.zh-Hans: 没能保存：有一个手柄按钮认不出，请重新选。
items.en: Couldn't save: one controller button isn't recognized. Pick it again.

items.zh-Hans: 没能保存：摇杆方向设置认不出，请重新选。
items.en: Couldn't save: a stick setting isn't recognized. Pick it again.

items.zh-Hans: 没能保存：有两个按键用了同一个键，改掉一个再保存。
items.en: Couldn't save: two buttons use the same key. Change one and save again.

items.zh-Hans: 没能保存：摇杆死区要小于 100%。
items.en: Couldn't save: the dead zone must be below 100%.

items.zh-Hans: 没能保存：鼠标设置认不出，请恢复默认后再改。
items.en: Couldn't save: the mouse settings aren't recognized. Restore the defaults and try again.

items.zh-Hans: 没能保存：鼠标灵敏度要在 0.1 到 10 之间。
items.en: Couldn't save: mouse sensitivity must be between 0.1 and 10.

items.zh-Hans: 检查这台电脑准备出包所需的工具和组件
items.en: Checks the tools and components this computer needs to build packages

items.zh-Hans: 出包的工作文件和缓存都放在这里，可以选外接硬盘（NTFS 格式）。换位置后要重新添加游戏。
items.en: Export files and caches live here. An external NTFS drive works. After changing it, add your games again.

items.zh-Hans: 点击检查，查看环境是否就绪
items.en: Click Check to see whether the environment is ready
The environment check did not finish
Version or setting does not match
Chosen by you, still needs verification

items.zh-Hans: 缺省位置按客户端所在目录推导，可手工修改
items.en: Defaults are derived from the client's folder; you can change them

items.zh-Hans: 后端检查报告格式无法核实，请查看诊断
items.en: The check report could not be verified; see diagnostics

items.zh-Hans: 未能启动环境检查，请检查路径设置
items.en: Could not start the environment check; check the path settings

items.zh-Hans: 环境检查意外中断，尚不能确认就绪
items.en: The environment check was interrupted; readiness is not confirmed

items.zh-Hans: 连接游戏库，选择自己的游戏原件；工作产物放在所选游戏库目录
items.en: Connect a library and choose your own game files; work output goes into the library folder you pick

items.zh-Hans: 把现有游戏一起搬过去？
items.en: Move your games to the new location?

items.zh-Hans: 游戏、已出好的包、着色器缓存和存档都会搬到新位置，不用重新出包。搬失败时游戏库会留在原来的位置。
items.en: Games, finished builds, shader caches and saves all move, so you don't have to build again. If the move fails, the library stays where it is.

items.zh-Hans: 先在上面填游戏库目录，或点「选择游戏库目录」
items.en: Enter a library folder above, or choose one

items.zh-Hans: 这个目录路径不合法（含不允许的字符或太长），换一个
items.en: This folder path is not valid (bad characters or too long); pick another

items.zh-Hans: 不能直接用整个盘做游戏库，请在盘里建一个文件夹
items.en: A whole drive can't be the library; create a folder on it

items.zh-Hans: 游戏库不能放在 S2Arm 启动器自己的文件夹里（升级时这个文件夹会整个替换，游戏会被一起删掉），请换到别处，比如 D:\S2Arm
items.en: The library can't live inside the S2Arm launcher folder (it is replaced on update and the games would be deleted); pick another place, e.g. D:\S2Arm

items.zh-Hans: 刚才的操作出了意外错误，已经中断；启动器可以继续用
items.en: The last action hit an unexpected error and was stopped; the launcher is still usable

items.zh-Hans: 原件只读不搬动；建议游戏库与原件放在同一块盘
items.en: Game files are only read, never moved; keep the library on the same drive as your game files

items.zh-Hans: 游戏库还是空的，先选择游戏原件
items.en: The library is empty; choose your game files first

items.zh-Hans: 操作未完成，查看下面的处理建议
items.en: Not finished; see the suggestions below

items.zh-Hans: 后端任务结果无法核实
items.en: The task result could not be verified

items.zh-Hans: 操作已中断，请刷新核实游戏库
items.en: Interrupted; refresh to check the library

items.zh-Hans: 先在游戏库连接游戏库并选择一款游戏
items.en: Connect a library and pick a game in Library first

items.zh-Hans: 已有 iPhone 包？装到 iPhone
items.en: Already built for iPhone? Install it

items.zh-Hans: 一个包，iPhone 和 iPad 都能装
items.en: One app for both iPhone and iPad

items.zh-Hans: 大游戏第一次出包要几十分钟，请插上电源、别让电脑睡眠。
items.en: A large game's first export takes tens of minutes; keep the PC plugged in and awake.

items.zh-Hans: 还没放入 prod.keys（解密游戏用的密钥），在游戏库导入后才能出包。
items.en: prod.keys (the key that decrypts games) is not imported yet; import it in Library first.

items.zh-Hans: 正在做别的任务，做完再出包。
items.en: Another task is running; export when it finishes.

items.zh-Hans: 按本机最近 {0} 次记录
items.en: Based on this PC's last {0} runs
this step by its current rate

items.zh-Hans: 这台电脑还没出过这种包，没有本机记录可以预计时间；这次做完后，下次就会显示预计还需多久。
items.en: This PC has no record of this kind of export yet, so there is no estimate; next time the remaining time will show.

items.zh-Hans: 这次没有收到步骤计划。
items.en: No step plan was received this time.

items.zh-Hans: 找不到 .ipa：装到 iPhone 时才会生成（整个游戏库共用一份），还没装过就没有。
items.en: No .ipa yet: it is made when you install to iPhone (one shared by the whole library).

items.zh-Hans: 找不到这款游戏的文件夹：所在的磁盘可能没接上，或文件夹被移走了。
items.en: Can't find this game's folder: its drive may be disconnected or the folder was moved.

items.zh-Hans: 用数据线连上手机并解锁。iPhone 版做好就能开始装；没打勾的项只是提醒，装的时候出问题会告诉你原因。
items.en: Connect the iPhone with a cable and unlock it. You can install once the iPhone version is ready; unchecked items are reminders, and any problem is explained during the install.

items.zh-Hans: 所有游戏都装进同一个 S2Arm App：免费 Apple ID 的 App 额度只占 1 个，再加游戏不影响已有游戏和存档。
items.en: All your games go into one S2Arm app: it uses just 1 of a free Apple ID's app slots, and adding games keeps the ones you have and their saves.

items.zh-Hans: 以前一款一个 App 装的游戏，存档不会搬进新的 S2Arm。
items.en: Saves from games installed earlier as separate apps do not move into the new S2Arm app.

items.zh-Hans: 把手机上的 S2Arm 装回上一版？
items.en: Restore the previous S2Arm on iPhone?

items.zh-Hans: 手机上的 S2Arm 刚换了新版运行层。新版不好用就装回上一版；游戏数据和存档不动，换完之后才装的游戏在上一版里暂时看不到。
items.en: S2Arm on your iPhone just switched to the new runtime. If it doesn't work well, restore the previous version. Game data and saves stay; games added after the switch won't show in the previous version for now.

items.zh-Hans: 只删这一款，其他游戏和存档不动。删之前会把这款的存档备份到电脑上。
items.en: Only this game is removed; other games and saves stay. Its saves are backed up to this computer first.

items.zh-Hans: 会让别的游戏暂时不能玩
items.en: Some other games will stop working for now

items.zh-Hans: 签名装机用 S2Arm 附带的 Impactor：第三方开源工具（MIT 许可，github.com/claration/impactor v2.7.2 原版，未改动）。Apple ID 密码只在 Impactor 里输入、只发给 Apple。
items.en: Signing and installing use Impactor, bundled with S2Arm: a third-party open-source tool (MIT licensed, unmodified github.com/claration/impactor v2.7.2). Your Apple ID password is entered only in Impactor and sent only to Apple.

items.zh-Hans: 这次没查到手机状态，可以直接开始装，出问题会告诉你原因。
items.en: Couldn't read the phone status this time. You can still start the install; any problem will be explained.

items.zh-Hans: 还差最后一步：在 iPhone 上打开 S2Arm 完成导入
items.en: One more step: open S2Arm on your iPhone to finish importing

items.zh-Hans:
把你的 Switch 游戏，
原生装进 iPhone 和 Mac。
items.en:
Put your Switch games on
iPhone and Mac, natively.

items.zh-Hans: 不是模拟器。S2Arm 把游戏翻译成苹果设备的原生程序，整座游戏库装进一个 App。跟着右边一步步做，就能开始出包。
items.en: Not an emulator. S2Arm translates each game into a native program for Apple devices, with your whole library in one app. Follow the steps on the right and you can start building.
Android and HarmonyOS are coming soon.

items.zh-Hans: 只有 NSP / XCI 需要。解包好的游戏会跳过这一步。
items.en: Only for NSP and XCI. Extracted games skip this step.

items.zh-Hans: NSP、XCI 文件、游戏文件夹，或解包好的游戏文件夹都可以，一次放多个也行。
items.en: NSP or XCI files, game folders or extracted game folders. Add as many as you like.

items.zh-Hans: prod.keys 是从你自己的 Switch 导出的解密文件。S2Arm 不提供密钥，它只保存在这台电脑上。
items.en: prod.keys is the decryption file you export from your own Switch. S2Arm does not provide keys, and yours stay on this computer.

items.zh-Hans: 任务结束后可更新并重启
新版的官方签名校验没通过，已停止，当前版本没有变化。
items.en: The update failed signature verification. Nothing was changed.

items.zh-Hans: 更新地址不是官方来源，已停止，当前版本没有变化。
items.en: The update source was not official. Nothing was changed.

items.zh-Hans: 游戏库或数据放在了 S2Arm 安装目录里，更新会影响它们。请先移出来再更新。
items.en: Your library or data is inside the S2Arm folder. Move it out before updating.

items.zh-Hans: 没有权限替换 S2Arm 所在的文件夹。请放到可写的位置，或手动下载新版。
items.en: No permission to replace the S2Arm folder. Move it somewhere writable or download the new version manually.

items.zh-Hans: 磁盘空间不够，当前版本没有变化。清理后再试。
items.en: Not enough disk space. Nothing was changed. Free up space and try again.

items.zh-Hans: 下载的文件校验不符，当前版本没有变化。请稍后重试。
items.en: The download failed verification. Nothing was changed. Try again later.

items.zh-Hans: 安装包不完整或签名不对，当前版本没有变化。
items.en: The package was incomplete or badly signed. Nothing was changed.

items.zh-Hans: 下载一直断开，当前版本没有变化。请检查网络后重试，或手动下载新版。
items.en: The download kept dropping. Your current version is unchanged. Check your network and retry, or download the new version yourself.

items.zh-Hans: 打不开下载好的安装包，当前版本没有变化。可以手动下载新版。
items.en: Couldn't open the downloaded package. Your current version is unchanged. You can download the new version yourself.

items.zh-Hans: 更新没有完成，当前版本没有变化。请检查网络后重试。
items.en: The update did not finish. Nothing was changed. Check your network and try again.

items.zh-Hans: 替换文件失败，已保留当前版本。
items.en: Replacing the files failed. The current version was kept.

items.zh-Hans: 新版没能启动，已回到原来的版本。
items.en: The new version could not start. S2Arm went back to the previous version.

items.zh-Hans: 新版没能启动，旧版也没能恢复。请重新下载 S2Arm，你的游戏库不受影响。
items.en: The new version could not start and the old one could not be restored. Download S2Arm again; your library is safe.

items.zh-Hans: GitHub 暂时限制了这个网络的查询次数（通常 1 小时内恢复）。当前版本没有变化，稍后再试，或打开下载页手动下载。
items.en: GitHub is temporarily limiting requests from this network (usually clears within an hour). Nothing was changed. Try again later or download it from the download page.

items.zh-Hans: 连不上 GitHub（断网、超时或连接被断开），当前版本没有变化。请检查网络后重试，或打开下载页手动下载。
items.en: Couldn't reach GitHub (offline, timed out or the connection dropped). Nothing was changed. Check your network and retry, or use the download page.

items.zh-Hans: GitHub 返回了错误，当前版本没有变化。稍后再试，或打开下载页手动下载。
items.en: GitHub returned an error. Nothing was changed. Try again later or use the download page.

items.zh-Hans: S2Arm 没有退出，这次没有更新。
items.en: S2Arm did not quit, so nothing was updated.

items.zh-Hans: 要先解压：把下载的压缩包完整解压到一个文件夹，再打开里面的 S2Arm.exe。
items.en: Extract first: unzip the whole download into a folder, then open S2Arm.exe from there.

items.zh-Hans: Apple 的许可不允许随包分发，要你从官网下载安装一次，装好后回到这里重新检查。
items.en: Apple's license does not allow bundling it. Download and install it once from Apple, then check again here.

items.zh-Hans: 允许 AI 操作 S2Arm
打开后，你自己的 AI 助手可以在这台电脑上替你操作启动器，每一步都显示在窗口里。
items.en: When on, your own AI assistant can operate the launcher on this PC, with every step shown in this window.

items.zh-Hans: 没有读到可用的文件，请点上面的按钮选择。
items.en: No usable file was received. Use the button above to choose one.

items.zh-Hans: 现在还有任务在进行，等它完成后再添加。
items.en: Another task is still running. Add this when it finishes.

items.zh-Hans: 已导入的游戏可以在库中查看。
items.en: Imported games are available in your library.

items.zh-Hans: 按原包大小留出解包空间，再加着色器的上限。
items.en: Reserves room to unpack the game, plus an upper limit for shaders.

items.zh-Hans: 可以装到你的 iPhone / iPad 了。
items.en: Ready to go on your iPhone or iPad.

items.zh-Hans: 可以在这台 Mac 上开玩了。
items.en: Ready to play on this Mac.

items.zh-Hans: 连上数据线就行，用你在 Xcode 登录的 Apple ID 签名。
items.en: Just plug in your iPhone. It's signed with the Apple ID you use in Xcode.

items.zh-Hans: 正在装到 iPhone：{0} · 查看进度
已装到 iPhone：{0} · 查看结果
装到 iPhone 没完成：{0} · 查看原因
items.en: Install to iPhone didn't finish: {0} · See why

items.zh-Hans: 已连接 {0}，会按这台手机优化。
items.en: {0} connected. The build will be tuned for it.

items.zh-Hans: 把 iPhone 插上，可以按你的机型优化，进游戏更流畅。不插也能出包。
items.en: Plug in your iPhone to tune the build for it and make games smoother. You can also build without it.

items.zh-Hans: 连着多台设备，会按选中的那台优化，装到 iPhone 时也装到它。
items.en: Several devices are connected. The build is tuned for the one you choose, and it is installed on that one too.

items.zh-Hans: 还是不行的话，把错误摘要发给我们，我们来查。
items.en: Still stuck? Send us the error summary and we'll take a look.

items.zh-Hans: 这款游戏的文件找不到了，请重新添加游戏文件。
items.en: This game's files are missing. Add them again.

items.zh-Hans: 这份密钥读不了这款游戏。请换一份从你的 Switch 重新导出的 prod.keys。
items.en: These keys can't read this game. Try a fresh prod.keys exported from your Switch.

items.zh-Hans: 已装到 iPhone · 还有 {0} 天
S2Arm 已更新。这款还能照常玩，重新准备一次才能用上新版的修复。
items.en: S2Arm was updated. This game still plays as before; prepare it again to get the new fixes.

items.zh-Hans: 游戏文件夹可能被移动或改名了。重新指定后就能接着用；从游戏库移除不会删除任何文件。
items.en: The game folder may have been moved or renamed. Point to it again to keep using it; removing it from the library deletes no files.

items.zh-Hans: 选这款游戏的文件夹（里面有 game.json）
items.en: Choose this game's folder (it contains game.json)

items.zh-Hans: 「{0}」的免费签名还有 {1} 天到期，连上手机续签一下。
items.en: The free signature for {0} expires in {1} days. Plug in your iPhone to renew it.

items.zh-Hans: 「{0}」的免费签名已经到期，连上手机续签后就能继续玩。
items.en: The free signature for {0} has expired. Plug in your iPhone to renew it.

items.zh-Hans: 没能刷新游戏库，显示的是上次的列表：{0}
items.en: Couldn't refresh the library. This is the list from last time: {0}

items.zh-Hans: 显示的是上次的列表，正在刷新…
items.en: Showing the list from last time. Refreshing…

items.zh-Hans: 几款共用的原件按款数平摊
items.en: Game files shared by several games are split between them

items.zh-Hans: 未统计（出包或清缓存后会统计；打开存储总览也会统计）
items.en: Not counted yet (counted after exporting or clearing the cache, or when you open the storage overview)

items.zh-Hans: S2Arm 占用 {0} · 剩余 {1} / 共 {2}
游戏宿主、iPhone 壳与引擎副本
items.en: Game hosts, iPhone shell and engine copies

items.zh-Hans: 改完下次启动游戏时生效，不用重新准备。
items.en: Changes apply the next time you start the game. No need to prepare it again.

items.zh-Hans: 会删除这款的安装包、资源包和缓存。存档和你的游戏原文件都会保留。
items.en: Removes this game's app, resources and caches. Your saves and original game files are kept.

items.zh-Hans: 第一次打开前，在 iPhone 的「设置 › 通用 › VPN 与设备管理」里信任你的 Apple ID。
items.en: Before opening it the first time, trust your Apple ID in Settings › General › VPN & Device Management on your iPhone.

items.zh-Hans: 免费 Apple ID 签的 App 7 天后到期，到时回到这里点「续签」就行。
items.en: Apps signed with a free Apple ID expire after 7 days. Come back and tap Renew.

items.zh-Hans: 把游戏装到 iPhone 要用 Apple ID 签名，免费的就行。只出包可以先不登录。
items.en: Installing on iPhone needs an Apple ID to sign the app, and a free one is fine. You can build without it.

items.zh-Hans: 点菜单 Xcode › Settings › Apple Accounts
点 + 添加你的 Apple ID
items.en: Click + and add your Apple ID

items.zh-Hans: 选中账号，等团队列表显示出来
items.en: Select the account and wait for its team list to appear

items.zh-Hans: 装了多个 Xcode 也只要登一个，账号是共用的。
items.en: With several Xcode versions, signing in to one is enough. They share accounts.

items.zh-Hans: Apple ID 已经登录，但这台 Mac 还没有签名团队。先把游戏做好，到「装到 iPhone」页点「解决办法」，按引导在 Xcode 运行一次。
items.en: Your Apple ID is signed in, but this Mac has no signing team yet. Export a game, then click How to fix on the Install on iPhone page and run the helper project once in Xcode.

items.zh-Hans: 第一次安装时，Mac 会弹出钥匙串授权窗口：输入这台 Mac 的登录密码，点「始终允许」，否则安装会一直等到超时。
items.en: The first time you install, your Mac asks for Keychain access. Enter your Mac login password and click Always Allow, or the install will wait until it times out.

items.zh-Hans: S2Arm 自带了大部分工具，只差下面几样。
items.en: S2Arm brings most of its tools. These few need to be installed first.

items.zh-Hans: 用你在 Impactor 登录的 Apple ID 签名，连上数据线就行。
items.en: Signed with the Apple ID you use in Impactor. Just plug in your iPhone.

items.zh-Hans:
把你的 Switch 游戏，
原生装进 iPhone 和 iPad。
items.en:
Put your Switch games on
iPhone and iPad, natively.

items.zh-Hans: 不是模拟器。S2Arm 把游戏翻译成苹果设备的原生程序，整座游戏库装进一个 App。跟着右边一步步做，就能开始出包。
items.en: Not an emulator. S2Arm translates each game into a native program for Apple devices, with your whole library in one app. Follow the steps on the right to start building.

items.zh-Hans: S2Arm 自带了大部分工具，只差苹果官方的这几样。
items.en: S2Arm brings most of its tools with it. These few have to come from Apple.

items.zh-Hans: 这台 Mac 已准备好
苹果官方的免费开发工具。S2Arm 靠它生成能在苹果设备上运行的程序。
items.en: Apple's free developer tool. S2Arm uses it to produce programs that run on Apple devices.

items.zh-Hans: App Store · 免费 · 体积较大，下载要一段时间
items.en: App Store · Free · Large download, allow some time

items.zh-Hans: Xcode 已经装好，还要打开一次，同意苹果的许可协议。
items.en: Xcode is installed. Open it once and accept Apple's license.

items.zh-Hans: 把游戏的画面转成苹果显卡读得懂的格式。
items.en: Converts a game's graphics into a format Apple GPUs understand.

items.zh-Hans: 苹果官方 · 约 1 GB · 一键装好
items.en: From Apple · About 1 GB · One click

items.zh-Hans: 出 iPhone / iPad 版要用。只在 Mac 上玩可以不装。
items.en: Needed for iPhone and iPad builds. Skip it if you only play on this Mac.

items.zh-Hans: 苹果官方 · 约 8 GB · 一键装好
items.en: From Apple · About 8 GB · One click

items.zh-Hans: NSP / XCI 要用从你自己的 Switch 导出的 prod.keys 才能读取。S2Arm 不提供密钥，它只保存在这台电脑上。
items.en: NSP and XCI files can only be read with the prod.keys exported from your own Switch. S2Arm does not provide keys, and yours stay on this computer.

items.zh-Hans: 选择从你的 Switch 导出的 prod.keys
items.en: Choose the prod.keys exported from your Switch

items.zh-Hans: NSP、XCI 文件或解包好的游戏文件夹都可以。
items.en: NSP or XCI files and extracted game folders all work.
